fields.description: Van Sales: the staff sells and delivers from a van warehouse (stock loading, invoicing, delivery and returns in the app). Field Sales: the staff only takes orders and collects payments; invoicing, delivery and returns are done in the back office. Counter Sales: a cashier or data entry operator at a PC keys orders in fast on the Counter screen, sells from the Main Warehouse and invoices on the spot.
fields.label: Profile Type
fields.options:
Van Sales
Field Sales
Counter Sales

fields.description: Counter Sales only. Every new sale on the Counter screen starts on this customer (a walk-in customer, say), so the cashier can go straight to the items. They can still pick another customer.
fields.label: Default Customer

fields.description: On: stock is loaded from the Main Warehouse into the van's own warehouse and sold from there. Off: the van has no warehouse of its own and sells straight from the Main Warehouse (no stock loading).
fields.label: Separate Van Warehouse
Main Warehouse
fields.description: The warehouse the van is loaded from. Without a separate van warehouse this is also the warehouse the van sells from. A Counter Sales profile sells from it directly.
Field Sales only. Stock from this warehouse is shown in the catalog for information; it never blocks an order.
fields.label: Stock Warehouse (display only)

fields.description: Restrict drivers on this profile to customers in these groups. Leave empty to allow all customer groups (subject to Delivery Route territory restriction, if set).
fields.label: Allowed Customer Groups

fields.description: The Mode of Payment treated as this van's cash drawer for shift reconciliation. Falls back to the first cash-type mode in Allowed Payment Modes, then the literal "Cash" record, if not set.
fields.label: Default Cash Mode
Allow Credit Sales
fields.description: Off: every invoice must be paid in full when it is raised. Collections against older invoices are still allowed.

fields.label: Show Customer Balance
fields.description: Show the customer's outstanding balance and ledger to staff.

fields.label: Allow Duplicate Customer Names
fields.description: Off: a new customer is refused when one with the same name already exists.
Let staff add out-of-stock items to orders and submit invoices that take the selling warehouse into negative stock.
fields.label: Allow Sale Without Stock
Hide Items Not In Stock
fields.description: Catalog only lists items with stock in the selling warehouse (the van warehouse, or the Main Warehouse when the van has none).

fields.label: Return Validity (Days)
fields.description: Items can only be returned if this customer bought them within this many days. 0 = no limit.
Staff open a shift (cash float) and close it with a cash reconciliation. Turn off for staff who only take orders.
fields.label: Use Shifts

fields.description: Block orders, invoices, payments, returns and expenses until the driver has opened today's shift.
fields.label: Require Open Shift
Variance Tolerance
fields.description: A closing whose counted cash differs from expected by more than this is flagged Exceeds Tolerance on the closing and the manager dashboard. 0 flags any difference. Never blocks closing.

fields.label: Blind Cash Count
fields.description: Hide the expected amounts on the closing screen so staff count the drawer without knowing the target. Managers closing a shift still see them.

fields.label: Staff Can Close Their Own Shift
fields.description: Off: only a manager can close this profile's shifts.
Staff can pay an expense out of the cash drawer. Posts a Journal Entry: expense account debited, cash drawer credited.
fields.label: Allow Expenses

fields.description: Staff can hand cash over to the office mid-shift. Posts a Journal Entry: back office cash account debited, cash drawer credited.
fields.label: Allow Cash Deposits

fields.description: The cash drawer account. Left blank, the Default Cash Mode's account for the company is used.
fields.label: Cash Drawer Account

fields.description: Where deposits land. Left blank, the company's default cash account is used.
fields.label: Back Office Cash Account

fields.description: 0 means no limit.
fields.label: Max Amount per Movement
Staff Can Cancel Own Cash Movements
fields.description: While the shift is still open. Managers can always cancel.
Leave empty to allow every expense account of the company.
fields.label: Allowed Expense Accounts

fields.description: Used on orders, and on invoices when no invoice option is chosen.
fields.label: Taxes and Charges Template

fields.description: Ways of raising an invoice that staff on this profile can pick from (each with its own numbering series and tax template). The app previews the invoice number and totals before creating it. Leave empty to invoice with the template above and the default series.
fields.label: Invoice Options
Max Discount %
fields.description: Largest order discount staff may give, as a percentage of the line total. 0 = no cap.

fields.label: Use Customer's Price List
fields.description: When the customer has a default price list, price the catalog and orders from it instead of the profile's price list.

fields.label: Allow Zero Rated Items
fields.description: Off: an order line with a rate of 0 is refused.

fields.label: Print Settings
fields.description: Print formats the app uses when staff print from their phone. Blank = the doctype's default format. Credit notes fall back to the invoice format.

fields.label: Credit Note Print Format
fields.description: A Sales Invoice print format used for returns. Blank = the invoice format.

fields.label: Direct Printing
fields.description: Where each document goes when staff tap Print. Blank = the PDF opens on the phone. Printers are set up under Sales Printer and reached through a Sales Print Agent on the shop's LAN.

fields.label: Credit Note Printer
fields.description: Blank = the invoice printer.

fields.label: Default Expense Account
fields.description: Pre-selected for a new expense. Must be one of the allowed expense accounts below, if any are set.
